title: Crescent Moon
description: Draw a white crescent moon on a black background. Start with a disc of radius 0.65 centered on the canvas, and cut away a circle of radius 0.55 centered at (0.3, 0.12). What is left is the crescent, open toward the upper right. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 in both directions.
hintText: A crescent is one circle with another subtracted. Take max() of the big circle's distance and the negated distance to the second circle.
